title: Ujwalam game detector pack
description: Data-only detector pack for one game (data/games/<game-id>/detectors.json). Detectors are data; the engine in P2/P14 interprets them. ROIs are fractions of the detected game area, not the canvas. Weights, windows and cooldowns stay null until G3 proposes them from labelled data. `version` is the pack version for every file in the pack folder; game id, modes, game area, name matching and OCR are in game.json (game.schema.json), event catalogues in events.json, screen gates in screens.json. Cross-file checks: tools/game-validate.mjs.

engineVersion.description: Detector-engine function version this pack targets; packs are migrated on load.

game.description: Game id; equals game.json id and the folder name.

detectorMode.description: Modes a detector may run in; tag-only modes (dmz) are excluded.

mode.description: Omit when the ROI applies to every mode of the detector.

minTextHeight.description: Kill-feed ROIs: ignore OCR boxes shorter than this fraction of the game-area height (smaller HUD text that shares the band).

path.description: Repo-relative folder inside the pack's gitignored local/ folder (data/games/<game-id>/local/).

role.description: positive = clip signal; negative = the user died or lost (never raises a score); context = state that other detectors read.

screens.description: Screen gate: ids from screens.json where this detector may run.

regex.description: Pattern for numeric text such as +N.

catalogue.description: Id of the event catalogue in events.json that this detector matches (M3: medals).

stats.description: Match-stats reader settings (match gate, services/clip/match_gate.py): end-screen card score pattern, kills column headers, game mode names, which detectors mark a match end, the gap that joins end-screen hits into one match end, and how kill-feed lines are deduplicated.

scoreRegex.description: Applied to the normalised text (upper case, no separators); group 1 is the score.

modeNames.description: Mode names as shown on the top-3 screen. A string is read as itself (lower case); {text, mode} reads a name written differently on screen (e.g. with an ampersand) as mode.

spectateDetectors.description: Detectors whose hits mark the streamer as dead and spectating; own kill-feed lines read inside such a hit never count.

banner.description: W1 only (services/clip/match_gate.py banner_kind, banner_subtitle, classify_banners): tells a round-end banner (more rounds follow) from a match-end banner. kinds: centre-y range of the VICTORY/DEFEAT word box per banner kind (game-area fractions). subtitleRoi and subtitles: the line under a round banner, read as the pack's own text. followers and followSec: fallback for hits detected without a banner kind (a match end is followed within followSec by one of these post-match screens).

modes.description: Game modes (lower case, as stats.modeNames) this subtitle points to; absent: no mode hint.

sameBannerSec.description: Round-end hits of the same result closer than this are one banner (OCR gaps split one banner into two hits).

afterEndSec.description: Mode cues read after a match end (C2, summary-screen header): a cue counts for the match whose end screens ended at most this many seconds before it, never for the next match (match_gate.segment).

cues.description: Game mode cues (C1, C2): on-screen texts that only some modes show (C2: the mode name itself). A cue read inside the detector's ROIs is evidence that the match is one of `modes` (match_gate.game_mode).

signalRule.description: name_only: a detection counts as a signal only when the profile name is matched on the stated side; otherwise no signal.

logUnmatched.description: Also log detections without a name match (signal false) as evidence records for tuning.

nameSide.description: Which side of a kill-feed line the name must be on, or any for a screen.

while.description: Detector id whose overlay is on screen.

endScreenRule.description: How end screens combine into one match-level signal. A match may show several end screens.

detectors.description: End-screen detectors; each must have nameRequired true.

nameCheck.description: The profile name is checked on each end screen separately.

matchScore.description: Any number of named end screens count once per match for scoring.

reasons.description: Every end screen with the name is listed as a clip reason.

noneNamed.description: End screens without the name give no signal (never negative).

screenRequired.description: No end screen has to appear; a missing screen is not evidence of anything.
